decision: Class-4 (fuzzy/Levenshtein-distance surname) matching removed from match_amcb_to_npi.R by explicit decision: edit-distance similarity was judged too easy to satisfy for a reason unrelated to shared identity -- two different real people whose surnames happen to differ by one or two characters got the same name evidence as someone whose surname is a deliberately recorded variant. Strategy 3 (the stringdist()-based fuzzy join) was deleted outright, not demoted; evidence class 4 is retired and not reassigned. Class 5 (surname-component/fragment match) is unaffected by this change -- it is not a distance metric, it requires an exact token match on one half of a compound surname. Both A/B arms (the full 2007-2026 panel and the through-2017 base arm) were regenerated with the same fix applied, so this reconciliation compares like for like rather than mixing old and new matching logic across the two arms. Re-running match_amcb_to_npi.R also required vendoring norm_name(), first_initial(), rank_one_to_one() and safe_pct() directly into the script: the private sibling repo (~/isochrones) it used to live-source scripts/match_enthealth_to_npi.R from had deleted that exact file in an unrelated cleanup (isochrones commit 484d7405d, 'remove the ENT side lane'), and that repo's current rank_one_to_one() has since been refactored to require mysterynpi >= 0.8.0, newer than the ac42561b commit this project pins in ci.yml/nightly.yml. The vendored rank_one_to_one() is copied verbatim from isochrones commit 56471c3f5^ (R/npi_resolution.R), the revision immediately before that refactor and the last one compatible with the pinned mysterynpi. compute_match_score() was dropped from the required-functions list entirely: this pipeline's own header comment already documented it as unused here. Net effect on the ACTIVE subset (15,328 rows, the population the chart artifacts built on this freeze report): primary_midwifery 12,192->12,170, sensitivity_nursing 889->821, sensitivity_name_component/excluded 95->101, resolved-by-absence quarantine 5->5, contested quarantine 40->38, tied quarantine 1,476->1,400, unmatched 631->793. The roughly 166 ACTIVE people previously accepted or tied only via a class-4 candidate lose that candidate outright; most (162) end up with no candidate at all, a few surface a previously-dominated class-5 candidate instead. Whole-roster cohort_members 17,028->16,775; class5_candidates_held_out 153->163. Outgoing freeze archived at amcb_npi_linkage_FROZEN_2026-10-22.csv with its manifest (sha256 1a7bd6a8c8f1c08910d3f2a9cb24561ed858a6b1204bf2274fdd3a8bd0887da2), so the prior cohort stays recoverable; the two A/B input arms were archived the same way before being overwritten.
